title: Require backend account proof and refresh signed SDK account-switch retries
scope: Require configured backend HMAC account proof for every public identity link in all modes; preserve existing tenant/visitor/account/expiry binding, rotation and validation order. Add optional SDK proof provider bound to the captured visitor; signed 409 retry requires successful detach and fresh proof for the new visitor, at most once. Static proof never detaches/retries on409; reject changed-visitor async results. Update only current identity guidance and the two generated SDK bundles.
non_goals: No session capability/generation/ownership enforcement, cross-tab/ABA revocation, forwarding-pointer or public logout rotation changes. Caller-supplied userId equality is not trusted ownership; full W04/F04/F06/N05 remain open.

No new demo bypass, signing-strength/wildcard/rotation policy, real backend/SSO/secret provisioning, retention/deletion policy, scoring/learning/ledger/consent changes, new framework or broad retrospective revalidation.
No external network/cloud/deployment/credential/customer-data/operational scripts, stage/commit/push, cleanup or unrelated edits. Root alone owns tracker/journal/source-of-truth/acceptance.

criteria.description: Actual verification/router fail closed for absent/empty/unusable or other-tenant-only signing config and missing/forged/expired configured proof before session/cache/DO/cookie effects, across both host choices. Valid signed merge/idempotency/relink, tenant/visitor/account/expiry binding, rotation and historical site-assurance records remain compatible; existing pre-proof400/409 priority retained.

SDK optional getAssertion({tenant,visitorId,accountId}) sync/async provider takes precedence without static fallback. Capture visitor through proof and response, reject changed-visitor results. Actual SDK through real crypto/router proves409→successful detach→fresh new-visitor proof→one retry; static409 never detaches/retries. Failed/malformed provider or failed detach prevents another link. Preserve existing controls and publish both source-matching bundles.

Independent frozen actual source/baseline/fixtures/worker-proof review and exactK1 rerun; inspect worker app and separate browser-SDK noEmit, local SDK build/bundle syntax/scoped diff and relevant source/config/lock/output identity. Root separately accepts with historical qualification, failures and residual session/privacy/customer/runtime limits.
